rationale.verdict: Discovery of Yield Basis yielded 3 anchoring contracts: the YB ERC-20 token, a Factory for creating leveraged yield markets on Curve, and the deployer EOA. Website unreachable, no audit links accessible, and GitHub repo URL not yet pinned. Factory dynamically creates market contracts; full child enumeration requires state reads. Next runs should inherit these three core addresses and execute factory enumeration.

evidence.shows: YB token contract with ownable pattern; lists website yieldbasis.com and GitHub link; marked as ERC-20 on Etherscan with 18 decimals
Factory contract for Yield Basis; creates market structs with AMM, LT, price oracle, virtual pool, and staker; holds 546.7M crvUSD; admin functions for market creation and implementation updates
Factory deployment transaction from address 0xa39e4d6bb25a8e55552d6d9ab1f5f8889dddc80d (Yield Basis: Deployer) at block 23371076

unknowns: D2: yieldbasis.com not accessible; canonical deployments page not located
D3: no audit links in per-protocol context and no audits discoverable from fetched sources
D4: GitHub repository URL linked on Etherscan but full repo path not yet pinned to a commit SHA

D6: Factory creates markets dynamically (evidenced by internal transactions); full enumeration of created market contracts would require executing factory view methods like market_count() and markets(i) — capped exploration deferred to next run

protocol_metadata.about: Yield Basis is a leveraged yield farming protocol built on top of Curve Finance that uses a Factory pattern to create custom yield markets. Users can create and execute leveraged yield farming strategies using the protocol's modular contract architecture, with dynamically created market pools managed by a central factory contract.
